components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single main action of a step panel.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font: inherit; font-weight: 700; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 52px; padding: .45rem 1.5rem; font-size: 1.05rem; border-radius: 8px; border: 1.5px solid var(--accent, #12233f); background: var(--accent, #12233f); color: var(--on-accent, #fff); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .12s, transform .12s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.12); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #1c4fd8); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Secondary actions: white fill, ink border.
components.css: .ds-btn { font: inherit; font-weight: 700; min-height: 44px; padding: .45rem 1rem; border-radius: 8px; border: 1.5px solid var(--ink, #0f1b2d); background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--ink, #0f1b2d); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .12s, transform .12s; } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--surface-2, #f5f7fa); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #1c4fd8); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Register Tabs
components.description: Four step tabs on the navy shell; the active one is yellow and rises.
components.css: .ds-register { display: flex; gap: .35rem; align-items: flex-end; background: #12233f; padding: 0 1.25rem; } .ds-tab { font: inherit; font-weight: 700; color: #c4d0e6; background: rgb(255 255 255 / .06); border: 0; border-radius: 10px 10px 0 0; padding: .45rem 1.1rem; margin-top: .4rem; min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .55rem; cursor: pointer; transition: padding .18s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background-color .18s, color .18s; } .ds-tab:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / .14); color: #fff; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f2c230; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-n { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono Variable', monospace; font-size: .85rem; opacity: .8; } .ds-on { background: #f2c230; color: #12233f; padding-top: .75rem; margin-top: 0; } .ds-on .ds-n { opacity: 1; }

narrative.overview: A formula handbook with coloured register tabs, rebuilt as a measuring tool. Ink-navy carries the header and the primary action, cool paper-grey is the ground, white is the work surface. Every measuring device owns one register colour plus one symbol, and that pair follows the device through overlay, live card, chart line, table column and export. Dense, hairline-ruled, small radii, real blurred shadows.
keyCharacteristics: Colour never carries meaning alone; each channel pairs colour with a shape (circle, triangle, square, diamond).
Three themes (light, dark, high contrast) share one token set; all components read tokens, never literals.
One primary action per step panel.
Measurement numbers are monospaced with tabular figures.
Flat panels with a hairline border and one blurred shadow; no decorative gradients.

rules.name: The Register Rule
rules.body: Register Yellow appears only on the active step tab (and its focus ring and the brand pointer). Never use it for buttons, highlights, warnings or chart series.

rules.name: The Device Colour Rule
rules.body: A channel hue identifies one device and nothing else. It tints that device's live card, channel header, overlay, chart line and table column. It is never used for status or decoration.

rules.name: The Cinnabar Rule
rules.body: Danger red marks recording and errors only.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Any number that can change or be compared uses tabular figures.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: Components share the single theme shadow; do not invent per-component elevations.

dos: Do pair every channel colour with its symbol wherever a device is identified (card, chart marker, table head, run list).
Do use tokens (--ink, --surface, --line, --ch1..4) so all three themes keep working.
Do keep one primary button per step panel and give it 44px or more touch height.
Do set measured numbers in JetBrains Mono with tabular figures.
Do keep content legible in Beamer mode: large live values, minimal chrome.
donts: Don't use Register Yellow for anything but the active step tab.
Don't use channel hues or Danger red for decoration or generic status.
Don't signal state by colour alone; always add an icon, shape or word.
Don't add per-component shadows or hard offset shadows; use the one theme shadow.
Don't introduce glyph or emoji icons; extend the custom SVG set at 1.75 stroke.
Don't put everything on screen at once; steps are shown one at a time.
